race.comment: PRINCE OF DALA (4) got the job done first-up in an impressive display, running away to win by 2.6L. He jumps right up in grade today, but he looks a classy customer and he looks set to reach new heights. Maps for a lovely run and he can bring up back-to-back wins. TRULY LOYAL (11) flew home to win two back before finishing 1.1L away in a very similar race last start 28 days ago. Drawn wide again now so he's likely to get back in the run, but he's still progressing nicely and he can't be taken lightly. HERAULT (9) comes through the Belmont Guineas where he was solid behind Hot And High and PRINCE OF DALA. His latest trial was very good and Pike's booking adds confidence. Drawn out, but if he can pick up from where he left off, then he'll be right in the finish. PLATINUM SHOT (5) is racing well without winning and is worth including. FAST HARRY (8) can improve getting out to 1400m today.
